title: Wren and the Passage
premise: Petra Zhou, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, has survived by never staying anywhere long enough to be found. When a flood-choked river coughs up a salvage chest bearing the seal of Veyra—a nation erased from the maps twenty years ago—she recognizes the crest from her mother's letters and realizes the drowned wreck offshore holds the proof that could clear her name or bury her deeper. Racing a licensed salvage fleet across six tides, Petra must choose between the belonging she's found in the coastal village of Salt Hollow and the duty she owes the dead. In the end she surrenders the chest's contents publicly, trading her invisibility for truth: her name is cleared, but she loses the quiet life she'd built—and gains, at last, a place worth returning to.
about_author: August Okafor is a former river surveyor who spent a decade mapping waterways across three continents before turning to fiction. He writes adventure stories about people the world keeps trying to erase.

chapters.title: The River Gives Up Its Dead
chapters.summary: POV Petra. Guiding a wealthy client through flood country, Petra spots a chest wedged in the riverbank, stamped with Veyra's seal—the nation of her birth. She pockets it against every instinct, knowing objects carry histories and histories carry hunters. Emotional beat: dread disguised as curiosity; the past has found her despite twenty years of running.

chapters.title: Salt Hollow
chapters.summary: POV Petra. Petra shelters in a fishing village where innkeeper Maren offers work and, dangerously, welcome. Inside the chest: a manifest pointing to a wreck offshore and a locket with Petra's mother's initials. Emotional beat: warmth she doesn't trust—belonging feels like a trapdoor opening under her feet.

chapters.title: Six Tides
chapters.summary: POV Petra. A licensed salvage fleet arrives, led by Captain Ilsa Reyes, hunting the same wreck under government contract. Petra calculates the tide tables: six tides before the fleet's dredges reach the site. Emotional beat: cold resolve hardening into purpose; for once she's moving toward something instead of away.

chapters.title: What the Locket Knew
chapters.summary: POV Petra. Decoding her mother's cipher inside the locket, Petra learns the wreck is the Meridian, which sank carrying Veyra's sealed archives—including records proving her family was exiled, not criminal. Emotional beat: grief and fury braided together; her whole life of exile was built on someone else's lie.

chapters.title: The Debt Collector
chapters.summary: POV Petra. A black-market broker named Corvus tracks Petra down, offering protection in exchange for first claim on whatever she recovers. She refuses; he makes it clear he'll sell her location to both the fleet and her old enemies. Emotional beat: claustrophobic pressure—the price of survival keeps rising.

chapters.title: Maren's Bargain
chapters.summary: POV Petra. Maren discovers Petra's plan and offers her late husband's dive boat, asking only that Petra stop running afterward. Petra can't promise. They fight; Maren says staying is a choice you make daily, not a place you find. Emotional beat: love against duty made flesh—Petra wants to stay and believes she can't afford to.

chapters.title: First Tide Down
chapters.summary: POV Petra. Petra dives the Meridian ahead of the fleet, finding the archive vault intact but trapped by collapsing hull plates. Corvus tips off Reyes; the fleet changes course. Emotional beat: exhilaration curdling into exposure—every gain narrows her margin.

chapters.title: Corvus's Price
chapters.summary: POV Petra. Corvus takes Maren hostage as leverage, forcing Petra to hand over the recovered documents. Instead she trades him the decoy chest while slipping the real archives to a sympathetic archivist aboard Reyes's ship. Emotional beat: desperate improvisation; Petra gambles on an enemy's integrity.

chapters.title: The Sixth Tide
chapters.summary: POV Petra. Climax. As the fleet's dredges close in, Petra confronts Reyes with the archives' truth: the government contract is built on suppressing Veyra's record. Reyes must choose law or justice as the storm tide swamps the wreck site, nearly drowning them both. Emotional beat: everything staked at once—truth versus survival, with no clean exit.

chapters.title: A Place Worth Returning To
chapters.summary: POV Petra. The archives go public; Petra's exile is officially reversed, and Corvus is arrested through Reyes's testimony. Petra stands on Salt Hollow's dock, free to leave anywhere—and chooses to unpack her bag. Emotional beat: quiet, earned resolution; belonging was never safety, only the courage to be found.
